units.source_text: 妹山在纪州伊都郡，绪绝桥在陆前志田郡。

en.t: Imoyama is in Ito District of Kishu, and Otae Bridge is in Shida District of Rikuzen.

units.source_text: 此诗大意是：不知你是称妹，因而迷于失恋。

en.t: The general meaning of this poem is: not knowing whether you call her beloved, you are therefore lost in the pain of unrequited love.
